description_en: Deletes a specified application adaptation, or dissociates the adaptation from a specified image version
description_zh: 删除指定应用适配，或解除该适配与指定镜像版本的关联
name: DeleteAdaptor

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application adaptation to be processed. Required. It must point to the same application adaptation as AppId and AppVersionId
parameters.help_zh: 待处理的应用适配 ID。必须提供，并与 AppId、AppVersionId 指向同一应用适配
parameters.name: adaptor_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. Required. It must match the application corresponding to AdaptorId
parameters.help_zh: 应用 ID。必须提供，并与 AdaptorId 对应的应用一致
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application version. Required. It must match the application version corresponding to AdaptorId. This parameter is not the image version ID
parameters.help_zh: 应用版本 ID。必须提供，并与 AdaptorId 对应的应用版本一致。此参数不是镜像版本 ID
parameters.name: app_version_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image to be dissociated. Must be provided together with VersionId. If both parameters are not specified at the same time, the adaptation deletion process starts
parameters.help_zh: 需要解除关联的镜像 ID。必须与 VersionId 同时传入；两者未同时指定时会进入适配删除流程
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image version to be dissociated. It must be provided together with ImageId and belong to the specified image
parameters.help_zh: 需要解除关联的镜像版本 ID，必须与 ImageId 同时传入并属于该镜像
parameters.name: version_id

schema.description_en: The response of this API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Code.description_en: The error code. This field is returned when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this field
Code.description_zh: 错误码。请求失败时返回；成功响应可能不包含该字段

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful. A value of true indicates that the operation was successful
Data.description_zh: 本次操作是否处理成功。true 表示操作成功

Message.description_en: The error message or result prompt. This field describes the cause when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this field
Message.description_zh: 错误或结果提示。请求失败时用于说明原因，成功响应可能不包含该字段

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can provide this value when troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，排查问题时可提供该值

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. A value of true indicates that the request was processed successfully. To check whether the asynchronous task is completed, query the task status separately
Success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步任务是否完成须另外查询任务状态
